--This part is for setting up sample user.
--Skip these step since users are already defined in synapse
/*
SELECT * FROM RefRowLevelSecurity
SELECT * FROM [dbo].[DimAccount]
SELECT * FROM DimBank



CREATE ROLE SOLVENTO_INFRA
GO

GRANT SELECT ON [dbo].[DimAccount] To SOLVENTO_INFRA
GO


CREATE USER [jpvricafrente@chinabank.ph] WITHOUT LOGIN
ALTER ROLE SOLVENTO_INFRA ADD MEMBER [jpvricafrente@chinabank.ph]
GO
*/


-- Creation new schema for security objects.
-- It is recommended to separate these object from the data tables.


CREATE SCHEMA Security
GO

-- Creation of security function.
-- Function to define what will be use as filter on tables
CREATE FUNCTION Security.AccessPredicate(@BankSK int)
    RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
    RETURN SELECT 1 AS AccessPredicateResult 
	--update
	FROM DW.RefRowLevelSecurity ref_rls INNER JOIN DW.DimBank Bank ON ref_rls.BankID = Bank.BankID
	WHERE ref_rls.UserEmail = USER_NAME() AND
	(	
		@BankSK = Bank.BankSK
	)
	OR IS_MEMBER('SOLVENTO_INFRA') = 0
GO



-- DROP SECURITY POLICY rlsBank

-- Assigning of security filter on tables
CREATE SECURITY POLICY rlsBank
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimAccount,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimAccountHolderType,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimAccountProduct,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimBank,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimBondType,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimBranch,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimCardType,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimCustomer,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimCustomerAccount,
--ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimCustomerAccountProduct,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimCustomerEmployment,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimParty,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimProduct,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimProductGroup,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimProductType,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimRiskProfile,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimRiskRating,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimRiskRatingType,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.DimUserAccess,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactCardsCreditLimit,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactCardsOutstandingBalance,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactCardsRelationshipExposure,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactLoansCreditLimit,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactLoansOutstandingBalance,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactLoansRelationshipExposure,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactSecurityPortfolio,
--ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactTotalCustomerHoldings,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactTotalRelationshipBalance,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactTotalRelationshipExposure,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment,
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.AccessPredicate(BankSK) ON dw.FactTrustFundValue

WITH (STATE = ON);
GO


-- For turning off/on of the security policy
/* 
ALTER SECURITY POLICY rlsBank
WITH (STATE = OFF);

*/

EXECUTE AS USER = 'kbaliton@chinabank.ph';

SELECT * FROM dbo.DimAccount;
REVERT;

*/
